description:
[Filings Oracle] The 10 most recent filings across all form types (form, company, ticker, filed_at only) - Free. The 10 most recent filings across all form types (form, company, ticker, filed_at only). Full structured data, filtering and cursors need /v1/filings.

**Example:** `/v1/latest-preview`

Use when you want a free glimpse of the 10 most recent filings (form, company, ticker, time). Not for full structured data (use filings_search).

Behavior: read-only and free; no key or payment needed.
